title: How Many Samples Is RL Worth? Best-of-N versus RL Post-Training for Text-to-Image Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) on a reward that can be checked automatically has become a common last step in the training of text-to-image models. A simpler way to get more correct images is best-of-N: draw N images from the base model and keep the one that a picker prefers. We ask how many base model samples one RL sample is worth, and call this number the exchange rate. We measure it for Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and its public Flow-GRPO checkpoint on 398 new prompts in the style of GenEval, the benchmark behind the RL reward, with human labels on every prompt and two automatic judges other than the reward. The answer depends on the prompt. Four fifths of the prompts do not ask for a position (for example, one object left of another). On these, the base model catches up: best-of-16 with an off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) as the picker is about as good as one RL image. translated_title: RL究竟值多少个样本？文本到图像模型中Best-of-N采样与强化学习后训练的对比
translated_abstract: 在可自动验证的奖励上进行强化学习（RL）已成为文本到图像模型训练中常见的最后一个步骤。获得更多正确图像的一种更简单方法是Best-of-N：从基础模型中抽取N张图像，保留选择器所偏好的那一张。我们提出这样一个问题：一个RL样本等价于多少个基础模型样本，并将这个数字称为“兑换率”。我们在398个GenEval风格的新提示词上测量了这一数值——GenEval正是该RL奖励所依赖的基准测试——测试对象为Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium及其公开的Flow-GRPO检查点，每个提示词均有人工标注，并使用了除该奖励之外的两个自动评判器。答案取决于提示词的类型。五分之四的提示词不涉及位置要求（例如，一个物体位于另一个物体的左边）。在这类提示词上，基础模型能够迎头赶上：使用现成的视觉语言模型（VLM）作为选择器的Best-of-16，其效果与一张RL图像大致相当。而一个翻看最多3张基础图像的人就能找到一……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“兑换率”这一概念来量化RL后训练与Best-of-N采样的等效样本数，发现在大多数不含位置要求的提示词上，基础模型配合现成VLM选择器的Best-of-16采样即可达到与RL后训练图像相当的效果，人工筛选最多3张基础图像也能获得类似收益。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "exchange rate" concept to quantify how many best-of-N base-model samples one RL post-trained sample is worth, finding that on the majority of prompts without positional requirements, best-of-16 sampling with an off-the-shelf VLM picker (or a human checking up to 3 base images) matches the quality of one RL sample.
